settings.language.title: Settings: label of the Language picker.
settings.language.system: Settings > Language: the first option, follow the device's language.
chat.code.copy: Chat: icon button above a code block that copies the code.
chat.table.copy: Full screen table: icon button that copies the table as Markdown text.
chat.copied: Chat: label the copy icon takes for a moment after copying (shown as a checkmark).
chat.table.expand: Chat: icon button above a wide table that opens it full screen.
viewer.close: Full screen code or table view: icon button that closes it.
viewer.wrap: Full screen code view: toggle icon, long lines wrap or scroll sideways.
viewer.code: Full screen code view: its name for screen readers when the code names no language.
viewer.table: Full screen table view: its name for screen readers.
